notes.title: Lumberjack Dynasty – Update to Version 1.09.1
notes.notes:
Hello!

A further short update fixes a few bugs and updates the behaviour of the water surface, among other things.

Fixed

 Fixed a larger and rare NPC AI bug.
 Optimised some data traffic between the NPCs and path seeking modules.
 Cleaned up several constant buffer inconsistences resulting in wrong area boundaries displays for the moving quest which eventually may have led to a crash.
 Cleaned up the physics for several call orders for the cutting of small trees, which may have caused memory fragmentation after several hours of gameplay (resulting in an eventual crash after hours of gameplay).
 Various cleanses and small bugfixes.
 Fixed an issue that in rare cases caused further issues when unhitching the trailer during the introduction. 
 Grass from the hand mower should now drop properly to be picked up.
 Fixed an issue that caused building repair quests to be finished by driving away from target building. 
 Fixed an issue where NPCs could wander off too far from their AI paths and rarely could have get stuck. 
 

Updated

 Updated the reflections on the water surface.
 Improved the wave shapes.
 Improved sun and moon and the corresponding reflections on the water surface.
 Rearranged first intro cut.
 Several localisation fixes.

Hello Lumberjacks and Lumberjills

Another update coming your way. See all changes and fixes below:

Added

 Added info for pad controls in pad map menu.


Updated

 Proper label for the German voice over in sound options menu.
 Credits updated.
 Polish language updated.
 Proper localization translation for colour sliders when repainting a vehicle.
 Switched to a proper system font for 100% compatibility across system versions and player system rights.
 Reformatted some menus, info, prompts etc for better text fit.
 Optimised terrain GPU resources and display (cut down to ~25% vertices) This should also fix bugs where lower and less densw terrain surface was intersecting with normal terrain, like in steep slopes.
 Player can exit vehicles inside the OSB factory and area between pallet dryers.
 Added a more precise terrain shadow (doesn't render for lowest shadow setting). This should avoid dark (shadowy) places in small terrain spots due to low shadow mesh precision.
 More smooth transition between terrain texture layers.
 No gaps between terrain tessellation levels should be visible now.
 The quest info now displays full quest description instead of just title and following quip. Also reformatted a bit.
 Increased the running speed a bit.
 Coffee affects player's running speed, but not walking speed.
 Increased shadow distances and object detection angles (at no performance loss)
 Contained Avira's possible false-positive PUA messages.
 The custom video options menu features only 2 environmental reflection modes now (fast and detailed), intermediate is no more. Detailed is now more optimised than intermediate was.
 Properly calculated the water specular dispersion on shallow waters, which should look more natural now. In general water specular was all the same on the water surface, cutting off rapidly where the surface intersected with the shore. 
 Moved the Level of Detail transition for some bushes for improved visuals.


Fixed

 In some cases, the full screen mode of the game could veer to windowed mode and continue with its incorrect behaviour from there. Fixed - the game should now switch between full screen and the defocused state correctly.
 The new forklift was not fond of picking up pallets lying flat on the ground. Fixed.
 Fixed wrong text in the gamma correction (in the options) that appeared in a few languages.
 Fixes to several trees & bushes across the world.
 Fixed normal, albedo and dirt masks for old tractor - both old version and after renewal.
 Some terrain places were overlapping at different LoD level, causing flickering due to Z-fighting. Those should all be fixed now.
 Fixed the quest info overlapping with the calendar/cash bar.
 Skill menu was cutting down description text in several languages. Reformatted and fixed.
 Fixed incorrectly placed tire prints in the ground that resulted in deep ridges outside the tire. Tire prints in terrain now depend on vehicle size and weight plus tire shape.
 Several vehicles (like old tractor, old timberjack etc.) had an unused light click to turn lights off (since assuming they had working/back lights which they didn't). Fixed.
 Stump grinder wasn't blocking movement while grinding a stump - fixed.
 Ponsse Scorpion lacked a prompt about the saw crane movement - fixed.
 Wood selected from pallets bought from store was black - fixed.
 Fixed the NPCs clothing Z-Fighting when nearby, after rare animation occurrences for example Auntie’s pants.

notes.title: Lumberjack’s Dynasty - The Big Post Release Update
notes.notes:
Hello Lumberjacks and Lumberjills,

We are happy to announce that we have a brand new Lumberjack’s Dynasty update ready for you to download as of... RIGHT NOW! In it you will find a lot of new goodies, visual adjustments, and features along with many bug fixes. We can’t wait to show you all the new stuff, so let’s get straight to it.

From now on you will be able to choose one from two character models at the beginning of the game. Take your time and choose wisely because they have different abilities and they will come with a different set of clothes too. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35689372/6f210abcf26d684314127b173ab050d96d1d21a1.jpg
Different sets of outfits for you to choose from.

Once you’ve chosen your character, go for a ride in the new luxury sports car. Spoil yourself and take a cruise around Pinegrove. It’s fun and rewarding. If someone spots you in your hot new ride (by coincidence of course), expect to gain some extra Social Points! Speaking of cars, from now on you can also repair your old trusty vehicles. We’ve added a whole set of new textures and masks for you to use. Old classics with a new look. And that’s not all. Wheels of vehicles will detect the type of surface you’re riding on. A small detail that adds a bit of realism to your play.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35689372/def70bff393cf896086ac4b7110f816de317c0c6.jpg
A new luxury sports car is ready for a cruise in Pinegrove.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35689372/6f0b29206a843b96a4e64d076f12353dbe915767.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35689372/4f759c390ba1a6626e50e3adf9f5dd1ac505fa8a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35689372/0c4b1e8e0f7b4adc4fac6485912b70b351db5b67.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35689372/27e988a6d93dffd460d32b5c4b31906e2f8971cc.jpg
Just a small change can make a big difference.

With this update you can expect some changes with icons related to construction and renovation. You can find new icons for inner walls, floors, and ceilings, so it is easier to spot what you are looking for. To keep everything nice and clean we decided that only inner icons will be visible if you are inside, and outer icons when you are outside. A cleaner on-screen-look just for you. 

And finally, the icing on the cake, you will get a new set of recipes for top-notch meals. Go and talk to your Aunty or Bella and learn how to prepare these new delicious and healthy dishes and snacks. They are not only nice to  look at, but also very fulfilling. Eat them and they will restore almost 100% of your vitality. And if you are already full, you can use them to make some extra money. 

Read the changelog below to find all the details of all the new additions. And as always, let us know, in the comment section below, what you think about this update. We want to know your thoughts. 

Enjoy the new content and have a great time in Pinegrove!

Lumberjack’s Dynasty Team

notes.title: Lumberjack’s Dynasty - Full Game Release
notes.notes:
Hello Lumberjacks and Lumberjills,

It’s finally here! Lumberjack’s Dynasty is now out of Early Access and it’s now a full release! Celebrate this day with us by downloading the update and diving into what Pinegrove has to offer. To get you in the mood, sit back, relax, and watch our latest Lumberjack’s Dynasty Release Trailer.

[previewyoutube=Zv928JD76JQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Pack your bags, hop on the bus, grab the keys to your uncle’s old sawmill, and start your adventure in Pinegrove today. But there’s no time to waste! Roll-up your sleeves and renovate your house and restore the mill to its former glory. Cut trees, make a profit, build relationships with your neighbours and the community.

Once you’re settled, find love, get married, and become a father. There’s nothing better than sharing and growing your business with a significant other. But it’s not just the mill that needs your attention. You can grow your farm, breed animals (cows, chicken, sheep, and more), upgrade your vehicles and their parts in your garage, and take part in huge projects in your town. 

Pinegrove is waiting for you. It’s time to start your Lumberjack’s Dynasty. 

To find out all the details on our latest update, read our changelog below.

Until next time,

Your Toplitz Team

Update to v0.48i – December 17th, 2020


 Main renderer and postprocessing pipeline changes/improvements.
 Improved HDR->SDR tone mapping, colour scales & brightness scaling resulting in better colour and brightness balance, more natural colours, and image saturation. Also, no overbright (sky) and too deep darkening of the screen (looking at sun or bright elements).
 Better bloom both in brightness cut-off and bloom lens cross shape.
 Proper water brightness and saturation scaling, water specular blooms, and properly shadowed water sun reflection.
 Better ambient and overall light saturation at night.
 Better water reflections at night.
 Better balance between night & owl potion.
 Sky leak bloom as a proper separate effect and appliance (though still regulated together by blooms & blurs video options). Sky leak bloom is soft and uniformly blurry, while other blooms tend to catch shapes from bloom areas and lens.
 Unified translucent (i.e. window panes) lighting between separate meshes and instanced buildings. (far building windowpanes used to shine, especially at night).
 A bit brighter and wider headlamp light cone.
 Proper postprocessing pipeline fixing some old and irritating issues (like jagged edges on some objects in Depth of Field, not DoFing FXs or blooms properly). Also, DoF takes AA into account properly now. Also bloomed distances had slightly different colours and brightness/contrasts - fixed too.
 A bit improved depth of field blur shapes and distances.
 Entering video options menu while in game does not enforce any strict settings (like blooms, or near focal DoF). Every change clicked on and off is visible in real time while in menu.
 Sun rays are a bit sharper.

notes.title: Lumberjack’s Dynasty - Furniture Update Part 2
notes.notes:
Hello Lumberjack’s and Lumberjills,

Today we are releasing the remainder of our major Phase 3 content drop for Lumberjack’s Dynasty. 

First up, we’ve added new ways and features to interact with furniture. From now on you can move the furniture around in your house till your heart’s content! We’ve also added a new furniture category, which is Kitchen Furniture. Hopefully with the new additions, you can unleash your inner interior decorator.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35689372/e2a9c9c276d03afe8f5c08e80696b5136f076ff8.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35689372/2c5a268d1e9816b9321f558a6d5e8d7f81c7cf25.jpg

Example of interior arrangement.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35689372/e8f97c366c404f9d0e301266072a369c45996b5b.jpg

Example of your new kitchen.

We also worked on improving fishing to make it better and more fun. We added different types of fish species, with some more common than the others. There are also more locations where you can relax and catch something on the hook. To find out where the rare fishes are, you will need to explore the map and find those special locations yourself. One thing to keep in mind - to catch those rare species, you will need better gear and also skills. Becoming a master fisherman is no easy feat.

We’ve also added some more goodies for you, like new Chainsaws, new Treasure Chests to discover, new Skills to unlock, and we gave you more quality of life improvements too. To see the full list, take a look at our Changelog. 

Lumberjack’s Dynasty - Furniture Update Part 2

NEW TOOLS:

 Two new Chainsaws (you can buy them at the Lumber Market).
 Fishing Rod with a Trolling Spoon (needed to catch predatory fish: pike, perch, and trout).


NEW FEATURES - FURNITURE

 Furniture Blueprints:
[olist]
 Common.
 Rare - get them in NPCs quests (with random chance of ⅓).
 Very Rare -  get them in Level 3 Treasure Chests.
[/olist]
 New Single Furniture available to be created in the Factory.
 New Furniture Category - Kitchen Furniture.


NEW FEATURES - FISHING:

 New Fish:
[olist]
 Common (as they were, now roach and crucian).
 Rare (pike, perch and carp).
 Very Rare / Valuable (trout and tench).
[/olist]
Fisherman Skill added (3 stages of skill) - determining the ability to recognize and catch fish.
Fishing changes:
[olist]
 Rare and Very Rare fish have specific places in the world where they live. These places are not visible on the map. 
New Mechanics of Fishing - for a fishing rod with a trolling spoon.
[/olist]


ADDITIONS:

Treasure Chests:
[olist]
 Level 1 (Basic) - contain food, random gardening tool, and random gardening seeds.
 Level 2 - contain food, random tool (other than those in Treasures Chests Level 1), and random potions.
 Level 3 - contain food, tree seedlings, something precious and highest level blueprints for Furniture Factory.
[/olist]


FIXES:

 Fishing mechanic bug fixed - where fish sometimes were caught immediately when the hook hit the water.
 Furniture Factory price fixed (lowered).
 Pretty Flowers fixed - adding more honey and adding SP.
 Tree Planter fixed - not planting multiple trees in one spot anymore.
 Ponsse Machines Painting System fixed - now you can paint the whole vehicle instead of one part. 
 Plank Drying System fixed - planks are drying faster by 20% inside dryers. Planks left inside the buildings (every type but dryers) are drying 5 times slower.
 New Furniture layout fixed - furniture can be placed and picked up to be placed anywhere.
 Beds and kitchens in the store fixed - will no longer allow players to sleep/cook there.
 Fixed possible errors in the first font in item title or description for multibyte UTF8 languages.


Let us know your thoughts about the update below and we will keep you in the loop about what else that we are working on. We’re not finished with the updates. There’s still more coming to Pinewood. 



Take care and until next time,

Your Lumberjack’s Dynasty Team


Full Changelog (0.48h):

* Price for furniture factory lowered to 199000
* Easier (better) detection of furniture factory control center
* Furniture to spawn detects actual nearby vehicle shape (with some margin). Vehicles parked nearby no longer completely block the production.
* Fixed bug of pretty flowers not adding more honey and not giving SP.
* Prevented tree planter from planting multiple trees in the same spot when pressing F too fast.
* Painting a part of an auto connected Ponsse vehicle paints the whole vehicle, not just this part.
* Loading auto connected Ponsse vehicles properly restores color and dirt states to all parts.
* Added additional physics test for determining when fishing is possible (to not cast through walls).
* Increased effectiveness of plank dryers (approx by 20%)
* Plank palettes left inside buildings (like OSB building, or garage, or whatever get dried too. 5 times slower than in dryers, but still they do (and this is way faster than in reality). This means palettes left inside of unrepaired dryers will also dry up - just slow - and speed up after the player makes the dryer building functional.
* Old (basic) chainsaw has a proper icon reflecting it's actual look (color and rugged)
* Introduced 2 new chainsaws: faster and fastest.
* Faster chainsaw is being sold by Jack, fastest chainsaw is being sold by Ashton. Both are also sold by Eric at lumber market. May require to wait till morning for them to restock.
* Adjusted speeds and tolerances of chainsaws
* Introduced fish species: common (as they were, now roach and crucian), rare (pike, perch and carp) and very rare/valuable (trout and tench).
* Rare and very rare fish must have proper fishing skill to be able to recognize and catch.
* Rare and very rare fish have specific places in the world where they live. 
* You must have proper fishing skill to recognize a specific fish living spot. Proper hint is displayed in specific places if you have proper skill.
* Another distinction to the fish: common (as they were) and predatory (pike, perch and trout). Predatory fish require a fishing rod with a trolling spoon to catch. Also the technique to use this rod is different. You won't catch a predatory fish on a common rod and vice versa.
* New item: fishing rod with a trolling spoon. Added to several salesmen, they should restock in the morning.
* New mechanics of catching fish using spinning with a trolling spoon. It has to be pulled constantly, not too fast, letting it drop occasionally.
* We don't change catches on a rod, these are permanently attached. Buy another rod.
* Food made with a rare fish does not have it's value increased. But the fish themselves are more expensive when sold raw, so it makes sense to catch them.
* Updated speeds and times of pulling fish hook with and without fish.
* Pulling fish actually out of water happens closer to the player.
* Fishing mechanic bug fixed - where fish sometimes were caught immediately when the hook hit the water.
* If fishing outside of a special fishing spot or using improper rod for special fish in this spot, the player may catch roach or crucian with basic rod or pike/perch if using a trolling spoon rod. But not that often as in special fishing places with proper rod.
* Basically catching in a special fishing place with a proper skill and a proper rod will give that special fish. Otherwise using normal rod will give one of 2 basic fish, or using spinning rod will give perch but more rarely.
* All fish have their distinct models if caught and icons in inventory.
* Introduced treasure chests, 3 levels depending on player lucky man skill.
* Chests level 1 (basic) contain some food, random gardening tool and random gardening seeds.
* Chests level 2 contain some food, random other tool and random potions.
* Chests level 3 contain some food, tree seedlings, something precious and highest level blueprints for furniture factory
* Furniture blueprints accessible as items (similar to cookbooks).
* Intermediate blueprints are awarded in NPC quests (with random chance of 1/3)
* Advanced (highest) blueprints are found in the highest skill chests.
* Things can be stored in chests as well.
* The first fisherman skill is given by Ryan after helping him out with wife. Second is given by John after finding sheep for Mary. Third will be given in incoming quests.
 * First luckyman skill is now given after finding and bringing Christine. Second luckyman skill is given after saving deer with Logan. This is new. (third will be given in incoming quests).  
* When hovering a mouse over a furniture icon in inventory, 3D furniture model is displayed.
* introduced manual furniture in the form of single furniture objects (chairs, tables etc), not crates.
* There's old furniture (all over the player house for instance) and new furniture in many types and forms.
* New single furniture can be created in a factory. There's an additional button in FF control menu.
* New furniture is created piece by piece and a proper wood amount is used as displayed on the left side of the menu.
* The same rules apply, so furniture drops must have an empty place, and a proper amount of wood has to be in the factory.
* Single furniture is created immediately, not after some time like the crate is. Just press a button.
* Created furniture has proper wood type visible on object as selected (pine, oak etc)
* Added new furniture category: kitchen furniture
* All furniture pieces have actual individual names instead of name+numbers
* Furniture creation levels 1 and 2 (count starts at 0 being basic) require blueprints now.
* Changed rotation of rendered furniture = always showing front at different angles.
* Furniture all over the world properly loads and saves.
* Unlocked blueprints properly load and save.
* New single furniture can also be bought in the store, but wood is not selectable there. Only what the store offers.
* Store furniture can be bought (and prompt is displayed) only if the player can afford this furniture. If he/she cannot, the furniture is highlighted green, but cannot be bought.
* New furniture, when belonging to the player, can be placed (if possible, i.e not too tight) and picked up to be placed anywhere else.
* Furniture put from inventory into furniture stores is automatically sold, so be careful. Proper prompt is displayed of course.
* Furniture picked up lands in player inventory, where it can be used to be put back again.
* Furniture created by the player properly remembers class, wood type etc throughout the inventory and saves.
* Optimised item titles and descriptions change when changing language
* Old furniture cannot be placed in inventory (picked up). It can be removed permanently (trashed). Player gets social points for trashing old furniture, but then has to replace it with new furniture if he wants any in the house.
* Furniture can be manipulated only if no other tool is selected, so no chainsaws, hammers of fishing rods in hand.
* When hands free and the player switches to Engineer Sight (RMB by default), he can manipulate furniture.
* When hands free and Engineer Sight is on, players can see furniture highlighted green for new (manipulable/buyable) furniture or yellow for old (removable only) furniture.
* When looking at furniture pieces, specific commands are prompted. So for example a player can look at bed and use E to go to sleep as usual, but when he is hands free and looks at the bed with ES, he can pick up (or remove if old) the bed and this is reflected with proper command prompt.
When hovering a mouse over a specific furniture icon, this specific furniture gets rendered in 3D in item description so it can be seen in detail.
* Specific player actions (sleeping, cooking) are not recognizable by a fixed marker now, but by an actual piece of furniture. So removing the old kitchen means the player will not be able to cook unless he/she buys/builds a new one. This means the player can rearrange his house not only visually, but also functionally.
* Fixed beds and kitchens in the store allowed sleeping/cooking there.
* Fixed possible errors in first font in item title or description for multibyte UTF8 languages.
* Improved textures and overall quality of Christine (uncle's pickup).
* Added new vehicle - lawnmower. In the western vehicle store.
* Lawnmower has a bit wider cutting range to make cutting faster.
* New set of sounds for lawn mower.

notes.title: Herbalism and Cooking Update - May 28th, 2020
notes.notes:
Hello Lumberjacks and Lumberjills,

We have some good news for you all - we have a new content update for you today. We called it the Herbalism and Cooking Update. In it, you will find new vegetables that you can grow, 8 different kinds of herbs that can be used to produce shampoo, lotions, and various potions. You will also find four new cooking recipe books (egg-based, fish-based, honey-based, and mushroom-based), which if you read them, it will give you new cooking skills.

Apart from this new content, we have also fixed and patched up a few things too. If you want to know the details about this new Lumberjack’s Dynasty update, then look below and find out all the details.

Bug-Fixes and Content Update to v0.43e

 Fixed several issues with new bushes (pine bushes) – calculation was done into 2D.
 Update 0.43c introduced bugs of partially multiplying building parts, this should be fixed now.
 Added 4 more greenhouse vegetables: paprika, chili, cucumber, melon.
 Greenhouse seedlings have icons as per inventory icons
 Pantry is full of stuff now.
 Pantry storage/inventory operational
 Apple trees could have been cut as bushes - fixed.
 Button farm statistics was checking if player has 200 euro to activate - fixed.
 Herbs and strawberries lit in ES (Engineer Sight) are displayed with proper animated transparency.
 Prices of milk and eggs lowered in the stores - since player cannot create these (yet), these should be cheap to buy.
 Added 8 different herbs.
 Two herbs are addons to elixirs and lotions.
 One herb is needed to create a shampoo, 1 herb to create a lotion. These are not consumable, for sale only.
 One common herb creates a strength potion - while it lasts player does not get too tired (down to 60% max, can run with logs)
 One common herb creates a worker potion - while it lasts chainsaw works faster and repair/rebuild works faster.
 One rare herb creates a see-at-night potion
 One rare herb creates a potion that removes tiredness and hunger completely while it lasts
 All potions and elixirs require honey and two herbs to create - one main herb and one addon herb.
 Potions when drunk and effects lasting are seen on-screen as bottle icons with time bars
 Potions effects overlap (different potions can be drunk at the same time), but do not accumulate (so drinking the same potion twice does not create 2x stronger/longer effect)
 Sun potion sets players food and stamina at max while it lasts
 Mountain potion decreases player hunger and sleep speed. Also hunger and sleep will not drop below 60%. Also, player can run with logs.
 Fox potion speeds up construction work and cutting trees
 Owl potion improves light perception at night. Does not affect day to not overdo the effect.
 The kitchen is now active.
 Kitchen menu divided into 4 categories: basic food (canned), recipes from cookbooks (dishes), special recipes and herbs.
 First 3 kitchen categories depend directly on the progressive Cook skills. Last depends on ‘One With Nature’ skill (gathering herbs).
 First cook skill is given to all players (to cook better foods right away).
 Second cook skill is unlocked when reading any cookbook.
 There are 4 cookbooks: egg based, fish based, honey based, and mushroom based.
 Cookbooks can be bought at sellers', but not all sellers.
 Third cook skill and unique local recipes will come in scenario quests for chapter 3.

 
Bug Fix v0.43d

 Update 0.43c introduced a bug making steering log platforms exceedingly difficult (camera got too loose while fixing unwanted jumping). Has been fixed.


Bug Fixes v0.43c

 Fixed wrong calculation of new types of bushes in some farm cleaning quests.
 Properly visible boundaries of the area to clean up.
 Farm/house cleaning quests may have been impossible to finish due to some grass being hidden below buildings, terraces or other inaccessible places. Should be ok now, game cuts grass below buildings itself. Save compatible, so saves with unfinished quests should have this quest working now too.
 Sale prices for woodchips and bark reduced by 20%.
 Calculating objects visibility might have been desynchronized, which was visible for near objects and with quick mouse movements. Some objects were appearing a few frames after they should. Fixed.
 Fixed rotations of fishing NPC - they were sometimes fishing back to the water.
 Improvements to external driving camera code. It was jumping when driving/turning smaller vehicles - fixed.
 Improved carried sheep texture.
 Some water/bushes/trees fixes in the world.
 Some objects fixed (Z-fighting).


Once again thank you heaps for all your comments and feedback. Also, we want to give you a BIG THANK YOU for taking part in our Lumberjack’s Dynasty Survey. Thanks to you and all your feedback we know what you want to see more of in our game and what you like to do the most. Once again thank you for every feedback you send us. And if you find some errors or difficulties, please contact our tech team at: support@toplitz-productions.com. 

Stay safe, enjoy the new content, and see you in Pinegrove!

Lumberjack’s Dynasty Team

notes.title: Lumberjack's Dynasty - February Update
notes.notes:
Hello Lumberjacks and Lumberjills,

It’s the end of February and that means that it’s time for our next Lumberjack’s Dynasty monthly update. If you are curious about how the production is going: sit back and read it all right here. 

Let's start with the treasure chests, which we recently added to our game. If you played Farmer’s Dynasty, you know exactly what we are talking about. These chests are scattered around the world, hiding from plain view. No matter where these chests are, one thing is certain - there are interesting items hidden inside, waiting to be picked up. Those items are a great way to boost your finances, or you can use them as a gift for that someone special. The choice is all yours.

This month we’ve also managed to work a lot on the mechanics of the game itself. To be more specific, we polished the rebuilding functionality. Rebuilding materials are now integrated with the item manager and player inventory. Materials you pick up will now be in your inventory, and they can be used directly from there. You can also assign an F-key shortcut to any material (you can do it with other tools too). Only one kind of material can be lifted at a time, meaning that you can’t carry the whole store of materials as people aren't a walking warehouse (although it would be very useful during a large sale 😉). Once you've used up all the materials you picked up, you must pick up new ones from the next material palette.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35689372/9ea17e6dfb58ac26191938e6e3f14b298432aa87.jpg

While remaining about renovations, we want to mention that we recently added over 800 new building parts for rebuilding with different materials to the game. More materials mean more repairs, which means more fun. 

And finally, forest areas are being revamped. We want the game to have many diverse trees - after all, having more diverse forests means more fun in a game about a Lumberjack. Each forest will have its own specific tree species, so if you need a particular kind of wood, you first need to locate the forest in which that tree grows. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35689372/410ffe00677ee294f9cfc88e5ed51903a9ab2fd1.jpg

This was just a taste of some of the things that we were working on during the last month. There is a lot more happening behind the scenes too.  If you want, we are more than happy to share more of these production insights with you - just let us know in the comments below. And don’t forget that you can also follow us on Facebook, Twitter and Discord Server too - we would love to see you there and keep you in the loop.

Thanks for spending some time with us!

Until next time,

Your Lumberjack’s Dynasty Team

notes.title: Lumberjack's Dynasty - Monthly Update - January 2020
notes.notes:
Hello Lumberjacks and Lumberjills,

Well, what do you know - another month is behind us. Time flies. Not long ago we spent the Holidays with our families and today we are in a new decade. It's been a while since our last Steam Update, so let’s fix that right now. Let us show you what we’ve been up to over the last month. 

To start off, we’ve made improvements to our Repairing System. Repairing can now be done in sections, meaning that you can stop repairs whenever you want and continue later on, like in real life (some partners might not be too happy about that - I’ll fix the tap tomorrow Sylwia, I promise). Before these improvements, you had to finish the repairs by clicking x times to finish the section that was being repaired. And if you stopped it, for some reason, you had to start it all over again. Now, you can leave half-way through, do what you need to do, and finish the job the next time you’re repairing again. Makes life a lot easier.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35689372/85e9376b6478b5a9d080744e379fb42ea5fca86b.jpg

Speaking of repairing, nothing would have been possible without the right tools. Even the brightest Lumberjacks and Lumberjills don't work without their specialized equipment. Plus, they make the job more “fun”. That's why we've added a lot of new tools and scaffolds to our game. Because sometimes, more is better!

And last but not least, we've added an extra aspect to the game. In Lumberjack’s Dynasty, your condition affects your skills. What does it mean? It means that if your condition is low, it temporarily disables higher skills. So, remember, don't forget to get a good night's sleep before you go and tackle that serious task ahead. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35689372/5a1bb04b73c5741fb65e6a3bd38a41aa98136ca3.jpg

These are just some of the many things we've worked hard on over the past month. Let us know what you think about them and share your thoughts with us in the comments below. Also, if you want more Lumberjack’s Dynasty updates, follow us on Facebook, Twitter and Discord Server. And since we didn’t have a chance yet - we wish you all the best for 2020! 


Until next time,

Lumberjack’s Dynasty Team

Afterall, a game about a lumberjack should have the best “Timbeeerrr!!” moments possible. We’ve been tinkering with the tree crown simulation, and we feel we’ve made some good improvements on that front. Soon, we will be able to share the results with you so you can be a judge of that yourself.

And lastly, we’ve also made improvements to our menu’s/UI, AI, gameplay, and more. Looking back at it, it’s been a busy month! 

Let us know what you thought about our November update. Would you want to see more write-ups like these in the future? Maybe there’s something that you are curious about and want an answer? Let us know your thoughts in the comments below. And as always, join us on our Facebook and Twitter. And if you are on Discord, hop over to our server. We hang around there quite a bit. 

Until next time

Toplitz Team
